tests.requirement: Selecting an element in the preview: the next designer turn receives that selection through the server-built ExecutionContext, re-resolved against the caller's own current draft (D6)
tests.evidence: m3-designer.spec.ts › M3-T01 (server-resolved label/value in model input; ai_action.actor.selected_entity; stale selection re-resolved to null at execution)

tests.requirement: Forged, foreign, stale or malformed element ids are rejected; the turn runs without selection or fails closed
tests.evidence: m3-designer.spec.ts › M3-T02 (another store's element, wrong field, traversal, malformed, out-of-range, over-long: 404/400 and no run or message); designer-contracts resolveElement cases

tests.requirement: Designer sessions and messages persist across refresh and worker process kill/restart, are StoreEnvironment-owned, and execute through the M2 lease/tool gate (D5)
tests.evidence: m3-designer.spec.ts › M3-T03 (expired lease re-claimed, attempt 2, one revision, fresh read returns the conversation, rows environment-owned, completed turn never re-runs; a retried turn reuses the plan its first attempt stored, so operation replay by index cannot skip or misapply a change and no new model call is made). The M2 real-process kill test covers the shared worker.

tests.requirement: Every designer edit is a typed, audited, idempotent risk-0 tool call creating a new draft revision; invalid, extra-field or low-contrast output is rejected with no side effects (D12)
tests.evidence: m3-designer.spec.ts › M3-T04 (audit rows, action_key = idempotency key, replay returns the same revision; unknown op, tenant key, unreadable palette, hero removal, missing section, over-long text all fail with no revision)

tests.requirement: Revisions are immutable and append-only with a monotonic per-project sequence; concurrent edits on the same parent: one wins, one gets a conflict
Undo/restore to revision N creates a new revision equal to N and cancels in-flight designer turns for the project; a stale AI write cannot overwrite it (D8)
tests.evidence: m3-designer.spec.ts › M3-T06 (undo appends restored_from; restore cancels a queued turn and a running turn stops at its checkpoint without editing)

tests.requirement: Authenticated in-admin draft rendering reflects an edit quickly; promotion (risk 1) produces a real per-project preview build rendering the edited sections (D1, D9)
tests.evidence: m3-designer.spec.ts › M3-T07 (head config updated at once; promoted manifest v2 carries the revision; newest by sequence wins out of order); m3-designer-e2e.spec.ts › 1440px flow (draft frame shows the edit immediately; promotion runs a real storefront-core 0.3.0 build whose served HTML contains the edited headline, the element ids and the revision meta)

tests.requirement: Playwright/Chromium screenshot captured only from the server-derived preview URL, stored as tenant-owned media, recorded against the revision (D7)
tests.evidence: designer-contracts › screenshot network policy; m3-designer-e2e.spec.ts › M3-T08 (real Chromium PNG from the ready artifact, recorded against deployment and revision, owned media_file of the store only; another store 404; non-ready 400; limit 429; draft unchanged) and the admin screenshot button in the 1440px flow. Thumbnail URLs follow the file provider's backend_url (see docs/STOREFRONT.md)

tests.requirement: Draft and preview content never appear on live hostnames or another store's preview; nothing goes live (D9)
tests.evidence: m3-designer.spec.ts › M3-T09; m3-designer-e2e.spec.ts › 1440px flow (draft edit absent from the served preview until promoted; the other store's preview never shows it)

tests.requirement: Cross-tenant session, message, revision, screenshot, project and run ids return 404 on every new route and stream
tests.evidence: m3-designer.spec.ts › M3-T10 (six routes incl. SSE and screenshots, no leakage; staff read-only; unauthenticated 401)

tests.requirement: Prompt injection in merchant copy, storefront content or selected-element text cannot select a tenant, reach catalogue tools, set prices or stock, publish live, or emit HTML/CSS/JS
tests.evidence: m3-designer.spec.ts › M3-T11 (markup stored as plain text; body tenant selector refused; foreign photo, live publish and product ops fail; other store untouched)

tests.requirement: Schema v3 rejects unknown keys/sections, more than two variants, non-owned or URL media, javascript:/data: URLs; v2 upgrades to v3 losslessly (D4)
tests.evidence: designer-contracts › schema v3 cases; storefront-contracts manifest media cases; m3-designer.spec.ts › M3-T12 (owned photo attached; smuggled foreign media fails the build)

tests.requirement: Preview bridge postMessage accepts only the exact expected origins and windows; the preview gateway forbids framing; only the admin's own draft frame is framable, by the admin
tests.evidence: designer-contracts › preview bridge; gateway-hardening › no-framing headers; m3-designer-e2e.spec.ts › M3-T13 (admin pages frame-ancestors 'none' + DENY, /frame 'self' + SAMEORIGIN, gateway 'none'; merchant CORS allows only the admin origin).
